programme.title: 進化的奧秘 #6
Mysteries of Evolution 1 #6
programme.desc: 有人稱牠們為「活化石」,但這只是對倖存者的另一個稱呼.從鯊魚到鱟,這些動物的早期適應都十分成功,讓牠們數百萬年來相對地保持不變.

Some call them living fossils, but thats just another way to say survivors. From the shark to the horseshoe crab, these animals early adaptations were a success, leaving them relatively unchanged for millions of years.

programme.title: 動物玩學誌 #1
Animals at Play 1 #1
programme.desc: 在大自然中,年幼的動物大部分時間都在玩耍.從喜歡追逐的貓,到可以解決謎題的黑猩猩.新研究表明遊戲幾乎是動物學習的全部核心,它不僅是樂趣和遊戲.

Explore the ways that animals use play, including young gibbons in Thailand that practice falling from branches, elderly macaques that preserve their brains with playtime, and games that sharpen the profound intelligence of African elephants.

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #1
Great Parks of Africa 2 #1
programme.desc: 在海陸相連的公園中,自然元素相互結合,創造出美妙的多樣性.可樂色的水使森林變得翠綠和茂密.火與風促進多樣性的增長,岩石形成了眾多面貌的海岸線.生命在這裡茁壯成長 - 從壯麗到奇異,這是花園大道國家公園.

In a park where land meets sea, the natural elements combine to create wonderful variety. Cola-colored water feeds forests green and dense. Fire and wind fuel growth in great diversity and rock shapes a coastline of many faces. Life thrives here -...

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #2
Great Parks of Africa 2 #2
programme.desc: 在克留格爾國家公園北部,賴以維生的元素就是水.在炎熱和乾旱的土地上,一條絲帶在荒野中切割出可靠的路線.它是不論大小所有生物的生命線.

In the northern reaches of the Kruger National Park, life depends on one thing – water. In a land burdened by heat and drought a single ribbon cuts its reliable course through the wilderness. Its a lifeline to all creatures, great and small.

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #3
Great Parks of Africa 2 #3
programme.desc: 偉大的奧蘭治河有著56米高壯觀的奧赫拉比斯瀑布.奧赫拉比斯源於「oukurubes」這個詞,在南瑪改的土著語言中意思是「雷霆之地」,這片土地是一個苛刻和陽光充沛世界的中心,充滿絢麗色彩和雷鳴般的咆哮.

Augrabies is where the mighty Orange River plunges over the awesome 56 meter Augrabies waterfall. Derived from a word oukurubes which means place of thunder in the indigenous language of the Nama-Khoi this land is the heart of a harsh and sun-...

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #4
Great Parks of Africa 2 #4
programme.desc: 地球上從最小到最大的任何生物都離不開食物、水和住所,沿著非洲最大河流之一的河岸,一些動物極力求生,而另一些則茁壯成長.所有動物都為尋找生存所需展開旅程,牠們必須決定在何時何地移動來獲取成功...這就是贊比西河下游的神奇世界.

Food, water and shelter are essential to all life on earth from the smallest of beings to the largest, and along the banks of one of Africas greatest rivers, some animals struggle while others thrive. A rhythm drives all animals as they journey i...

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #5
Great Parks of Africa 2 #5
programme.desc: 在南非祖魯蘭中心地帶,有著非洲大陸最古老的野生動物保護區 - 赫盧赫盧韋 - 烏姆福洛濟禁獵區.南方白犀牛在動盪時期於此找到了保護.在19世紀末幾乎因為被捕獵而完全滅絕,公園的建立為犀牛提供了一條生路 - 讓牠們從絕種中恢復過來.

In the heart of Zululand, South Africa, lies the oldest game reserve on the African continent – Hluhluwe-iMfolozi. Here, Southern white rhinos have found protection from people in times of turmoil. Hunted almost to extinction at the end of the 19t...

programme.title: 海灘「龜」來記
Turtle Beach
programme.desc: 當成千上萬的海龜日以繼夜登上哥斯達黎加的海灘生下數以百萬計的蛋,當地人稱之為「到達」.本節目滿是新發現,加拿大自然學家及攝影師胡戈基奇跟隨一隊國際科學家團隊進行創新性的科學考察,以解開這個稀有現象的謎底.
Locals call it the arribada, or arrival. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #3
Wild Latin America 1 #3
programme.desc: 在秘魯的山脈,一小群眼鏡熊為生存而戰.孤兒阿馬遜娜必須學會獨立.老去的東哥沒時間找到配偶,很難才能俘虜理想對象曹莉達.
Get to know South Americas only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru.

programme.title: 鯊魚小隊 #1 [英/普]
Shark Squad 1 #1 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 在墨西哥瓜達盧普島附近,頂尖鯊魚生態學家莫利斯奧許尤士先使用遙視.他將攝影機安裝在大白鯊的鰭上,拍攝到一個獨特的視野,揭示牠如何游泳、狩獵,並且最終襲擊獵物.

Off Guadalupe Island, Mexico, top shark ecologist Mauricio Hoyos attempts a television first. Get a unique view as he attaches a camera to the dorsal fin of a great white, revealing how it swims, hunts, and ultimately strikes its prey.

programme.title: 鯊魚小隊 #2 [英/普]
Shark Squad 1 #2 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 前往巴哈馬的偏遠地區,解開鯊魚的秘密.牠們交友嗎?牠們在哪裡生育?有品種比其他大膽嗎?答案可能有助保護這些至高無上掠食者的後代.

Travel to a remote part of the Bahamas to unlock shark secrets. Do they make friends? Where do they give birth? Are some bolder than others? The answers may help protect these supreme predators for generations to come.

programme.title: 鯊魚小隊 #3 [英/普]
Shark Squad 1 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 海中最快的魚,尖吻鯖鯊通常是恆溫的,這使牠具有敏捷思維以及驚人速度的優勢.跟隨這種紐西蘭海岸附近相對未被研究的品種.

In some of the most-remote regions on the planet, researchers dive deep and brave danger to unlock secret shark behaviours, challenge myths about sharks, and fight for the protection of these supreme predators – before its too late.

programme.title: 鯊魚小隊 #4 [英/普]
Shark Squad 1 #4 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 鯊魚經常被描繪成容易攻擊人類的無腦進食機器,但是它們的行為比之前所認為的更加複雜和聰明.找出這些優雅的頂級捕食者如何互動,選擇朋友,甚至訓導其他同類.

Often portrayed as mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans, sharks are more complex and intelligent than previously thought. Find out how these graceful top predators interact, choose friends, and even teach other sharks.

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #3 [英/普]
Chasing the Rains 1 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 跟隨阿納斯塔西亞的足跡,牠的象群因為保護兩隻珍貴的小象而兵分兩路,而獵豹庫萊塔則為牠剩下的幼崽奪回領地.塵土散去,雨水開始滋潤乾涸的大地,加入野狗菲尼克斯尋找新伴侶的旅程.

Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenixs search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land.

programme.title: 大貓九命 #1
Big Cats: Nine Lives 1 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​描繪獅子生命的九個階段,從無助的小獅子到自信的成年獅,再到年老的流亡者.看看競爭、飢餓和驕傲的動態如何塑造它在塞倫蓋提的生活,並見證使這種社交貓獨特的忠誠和合作精神.

Chart the lions nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

programme.title: 大貓九命 #2
Big Cats: Nine Lives 1 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與一隻小小的幼獅一起在森林中穿行,觀看年輕的成年獅如何宣示自己的領土,並見證年老獵人的不可避免的流亡.發現本能和潛行如何幫助老虎在它孤獨的世界中生存,在這裡每一個決定都充滿風險.

Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

programme.title: 大貓九命 #3
Big Cats: Nine Lives 1 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在嚴酷的環境和不斷的挑戰中奮戰,看看豹子如何不斷智勝敵人以獲取食物並保護幼崽.穿越冰冷的山峰和乾燥的河床,在這裡任何的遭遇都可能改變這隻貓的命運,無論是好是壞.

Battle harsh environments and relentless challenges and see how the leopard constantly outthinks its enemies to secure food and protect its young. Cross icy peaks and arid riverbeds, where any encounter can change this cats fate for better or worse.

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #1
Snow Leopards with Dan ONeill 1 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與丹一同踏上旅程,穿越嚴酷無情的蒙古荒野,只為尋找那隻史上有紀錄以來體型最大的雪豹:「老兄」(The Dude).目睹他如何在充滿敵意、危機四伏的地形與環境中奮力前行,並在未知與不確定中披荊斬棘,同時揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面臨的艱難挑戰與嚴峻現實.

Navigate the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan as he searches for The Dude, the largest snow leopard ever recorded. Watch him battle hostile landscapes and uncertainty as he sheds light on the challenges that The Dude and other snow leopards face.

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #2
Snow Leopards with Dan ONeill 1 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探、追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵、更具影響力.當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰.

Sniff around The Dudes territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #1
Africas Hunters 1 #1
programme.desc: 本集跟隨一隻老邁的豹子三天,她正努力覓食,同時試圖避開惡魔般的鄰居:一個清道夫獅子群.

A revolutionary thermal camera reveals the secret world of nocturnal predators. Follow along as one of the oldest-known leopards struggles to survive her fearsome neighbors: a pride of scavenging lions.

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #3 [英/普]
Chasing the Rains 1 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 跟隨阿納斯塔西亞的足跡,牠的象群因為保護兩隻珍貴的小象而兵分兩路,而獵豹庫萊塔則為牠剩下的幼崽奪回領地.塵土散去,雨水開始滋潤乾涸的大地,加入野狗菲尼克斯尋找新伴侶的旅程.

Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenixs search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land.

A revolutionary thermal camera reveals the secret world of nocturnal predators. Follow along as one of the oldest-known leopards struggles to survive her fearsome neighbors: a pride of scavenging lions.

programme.title: 征戰火焰山 #1
Volcanic Odysseys 1 #1
programme.desc: 埃塞俄比亞的達納基勒窪地不僅是地球上最不適合居住的地方之一,而且是地質活動最活躍的地區之一.火山學家湯菲佛正帶著一群冒險的遊客穿過達納基勒去看爾塔阿雷火山.

The Danakil Depression in Ethiopia is not only one of the most inhospitable places on Earth, but is one of the most geologically active. Now, volcanologist Tom Pfeiffer is taking a group of adventure tourists to cross the Danakil to see the Erte A...

programme.title: 動物玩學誌 #2
Animals at Play 1 #2
programme.desc: 世界各地的動物會玩各種團體遊戲,從玩扯大纜的年輕鬣狗,到喜歡混戰的淘氣猴子.但為甚麼有些動物需要跟同伴一起玩耍呢?遊戲的規則又是甚麼呢?

Young hyenas compete in tug of war, mischievous parrots play at picking apart tourists cars, and Atlantic spotted dolphins enjoy sophisticated social games amid seaweed—all following specific rules that hone social bonds.

programme.title: 極限非洲 #1
Extreme Africa 1 #1
programme.desc: 南非的龍山是其中一處擁有大陸上最壯麗美景的地方.它的氣候和生態梯度急劇變化,亦影響著陸空生物和天上猛禽的生活環境.

South Africas Drakensberg is one of the continents most impressive landscapes. It is home to sharp climatic and ecological gradients as physical conditions change for both land-based creatures and the Raptors that swirl in the skies above.

programme.title: 極限非洲 #2
Extreme Africa 1 #2
programme.desc: 在坦桑尼亞北部,高聳的山脈形成一個巨大的山谷.它被古老的火山所滋養,坡道為生命提供了多元化的棲息地,而它巨大的重心地帶即使在最乾燥的時期也能保存水源.

In north Tanzania, towering mountains line a dramatic valley. Enriched by ancient volcanoes, its slopes provide a variety of habitats for life to thrive and its great centerpiece holds water through even the driest of times.

programme.title: 極限非洲 #3
Extreme Africa 1 #3
programme.desc: 埃塞俄比亞的塞米恩國家公園住著地球上一些最稀有的生物.窺探非洲最高峰的生活,那是在草原遊走毛茸茸的獅尾狒、神出鬼沒的塞米恩狼和有角的瓦利亞野山羊的最後堡壘.

Simien Mountains National Park in Ethiopia is home to some of the rarest creatures on earth. Take a glimpse into life on some of the highest peaks in Africa, in the last stronghold of shaggy, grass-grazing Geladas, elusive Simien wolves and horned...

programme.title: 極限非洲 #4
Extreme Africa 1 #4
programme.desc: 進入南部旱地是一趟非洲南部最遠端、最乾旱和極端環境的旅程.我們到訪了幾乎不降雨,既壯觀又危險的地方,為了尋找適應力極強的動物,並了解牠們生存的秘密.從最大的哺乳類到最敏捷的昆蟲,甚至是世上僅有幽靈般的魚類,南部旱地擁有非凡的居民,生活在世上其中一處最荒涼的棲息地接受日常挑戰,牠們都站在同一陣線.

The Southern Drylands is a journey into the most arid and extreme environments in the furthest reaches of southern Africa. We go to spectacular but treacherous places where almost no rain falls, to find incredibly resilient creatures and learn the...

programme.title: 極限非洲 #5
Extreme Africa 1 #5
programme.desc: 現已乾涸的埃托沙曾是一個大湖,現在只有夏季降雨期間才能季節性地補充水分.但當埃托沙充滿水時,無數的水鳥就會聚集在淺湖中繁殖,最常見的是大小紅鸛.

Etosha was once a great lake that dried up and now only fills with water seasonally during the summer rains. Once the Etosha pan is full of water, a myriad of water birds congregate in the shallow lake to breed, most notably Greater and lesser fla...

programme.title: 極限非洲 #6
Extreme Africa 1 #6
programme.desc: 沿著南非的奧蘭治河,從它的源頭到大西洋出海處.我們在沿途能遇到各樣的棲息地和當中的生物,從理察斯維德的旱地到奧赫拉比斯的美景; 這是一個線形綠洲的故事.我們將揭示生物如何適應其河道,並發現豐富的動植物世界.

Follow the course of South Africas Orange river from its origins to where it spills out into the Atlantic Ocean. Along the way we encounter a diverse range of habitats and the creatures they support, from the dry lands of the Richtersveld to the ...

programme.title: 「礁」來船禍 #5
Reef Wrecks 1 #5
programme.desc: 從機會主義的海盜船到裝備精良的海軍艦艇,墨西哥的尤卡坦半島沉浸在海事的歷史中.
From opportunistic pirate ships, to well-armed navy vessels, Mexicos Yucatan Peninsula is steeped in maritime history.

programme.title: 尚比亞野生故事 #1
Tales from Zambia 2 #1
programme.desc: 在這片小林地中,兩隻幼猴面臨一生中最艱難的日子.牠們要在世上找到一席之地時,必須瞭解哪些鄰居是盟友,哪些是敵人;誰值得信賴,誰應該避開.牠們會失去或得到朋友,這樣才算是林地的一份子.

In this small patch of woodland, two young monkeys face the toughest time of their lives. As they find their place in the world, they must learn which neighbors are allies, and which are foes. Who to trust, and who to avoid. They will suffer loss,...

programme.title: 尚比亞野生故事 #2
Tales from Zambia 2 #2
programme.desc: 尚比亞的荒野是一個難以生存的地方.這裡許多動物都必須成群結隊來幫忙保衛領土、保護後代、覓食和對抗掠食者.
The wilds of Zambia are a tough place to live. Here, many animals must come together in groups to help defend territory, protect offspring, find food and overcome predators.

programme.title: 尚比亞野生故事 #3
Tales from Zambia 2 #3
programme.desc: 每天在盧安瓜谷都會看到一具動物屍體.每一具都擁有導致牠們死亡的故事.在草原狩獵鑑證科中,我們調查已發現的3具屍體的死亡個案...
Everyday in the Luangwa Valley a carcass is sighted. Each body holds the story that lead them to their death. In Safari CSI we investigate what killed three carcasses that have been uncovered...

programme.title: 尚比亞野生故事 #4
Tales from Zambia 2 #4
programme.desc: 尚比亞擁有三個非常特殊和不同的非洲伊甸園.位於低處又炎熱的是盧安瓜河谷,高處又乾旱的是柳瓦平原,而涼爽濕潤的是卡桑卡國家公園.這些特質由它們的所在和季節所塑造,每個地方都為選擇於那定居的野生動物提供獨特的東西.

Zambia is home to three very special and different African Edens. The low, hot Luangwa River Valley, the high, dry Liuwa Plain and the cool, wet Kasanka National Park. Defined by the earth on which they sit and shaped by the seasons, each place of...

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #4 [英/普]
Wildlife Icons 2 #4 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 在非洲大草原上生存需要機智和奸狡,特別是兩名獵人:非洲野狗和侏獴.這兩種神秘的物種都是群居,並依靠良好協調的團隊合作來取得成功.從照顧初生之犢到尋找食物和抵禦敵人.牠們都依靠緊密的家庭來克服日常的挑戰.

Surviving the African savanna requires guile and teamwork for species who live in packs. Follow a day in the life of African wild dogs and dwarf mongooses to see how they rely on their tight-knit families to overcome the challenging landscape.

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #5 [英/普]
Wildlife Icons 2 #5 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 一個複雜的關係網絡統治著地球上的所有生命 - 所有物種都相互聯繫,沒有一個能獨善其身.某些關係是單向的,但其他則是互利的.從鬆散的協力到緊密的伙伴關係,一切盡在大自然的偉大計劃之中.物種之間複雜的互動關係甚至不僅限於動物 - 一些最好的例子發生在非洲茂密的山林中.

A complex web of relationships rules all life on earth: all species are interconnected, none can survive in isolation. While some relationships are one-sided, others are mutually beneficial. From loose associations to tight-knit partnerships, ever...

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #6 [英/普]
Wildlife Icons 2 #6 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 尼羅鱷和河馬是非洲兩種淡水兩棲類的表表者,在整個非洲大陸的水道、河流和湖泊中都有其蹤影,亦包括南非夸祖魯納塔爾省的壯麗荒野.這兩個物種共存數千年,以不同的方式進化成依水而生.

The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africas amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent, including the stunning wilderness of Kwa-Zulu Natal in South Africa. These two species have co-existed ...

programme.title: 巨象同盟:長牙兄弟情
Tusker: Brotherhood of Elephants
programme.desc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象:克雷格、帕斯卡與以掃.深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言、複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結.

Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the worlds largest land mammal.

programme.title: 大象傳奇 [英/普]
The Great Elephant Tale [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 《大象傳奇》有三個故事.一頭牛犢穿越奧卡萬戈三角洲.一頭公牛正尋覓伴侶.一位女族長帶領家人穿過沙漠.這些個別的冒險故事一同敍述了非洲最具標誌性物種之一的故事.

Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

programme.title: 啄木鳥:樹洞故事
Woodpeckers: The Hole Story
programme.desc: 伴隨著一個獨特的鳥類家族的穩定鼓點行進.了解為何世界上從大到小的239種啄木鳥都是自然界最好的伐木工;探索牠們的飛行、攀爬和呼叫技能;進入牠們的秘密巢穴一探究竟.

March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the worlds 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are natures best lumberjacks; explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills; and get a look inside their secret nests.

programme.title: 祕「蜜」日記 [英/普]
A Bees Diary [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 在蜂巢內,成千上萬的小動物朝著一個共同目標努力:群體的生存.但是個別蜜蜂的生活又如何?《秘「蜜」日記》講述這個故事.
In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bees Diary tells that story.

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #4 [英/普]
Wildlife Icons 2 #4 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 在非洲大草原上生存需要機智和奸狡,特別是兩名獵人:非洲野狗和侏獴.這兩種神秘的物種都是群居,並依靠良好協調的團隊合作來取得成功.從照顧初生之犢到尋找食物和抵禦敵人.牠們都依靠緊密的家庭來克服日常的挑戰.

Surviving the African savanna requires guile and teamwork for species who live in packs. Follow a day in the life of African wild dogs and dwarf mongooses to see how they rely on their tight-knit families to overcome the challenging landscape.

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #5 [英/普]
Wildlife Icons 2 #5 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 一個複雜的關係網絡統治著地球上的所有生命 - 所有物種都相互聯繫,沒有一個能獨善其身.某些關係是單向的,但其他則是互利的.從鬆散的協力到緊密的伙伴關係,一切盡在大自然的偉大計劃之中.物種之間複雜的互動關係甚至不僅限於動物 - 一些最好的例子發生在非洲茂密的山林中.

A complex web of relationships rules all life on earth: all species are interconnected, none can survive in isolation. While some relationships are one-sided, others are mutually beneficial. From loose associations to tight-knit partnerships, ever...

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #6 [英/普]
Wildlife Icons 2 #6 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 尼羅鱷和河馬是非洲兩種淡水兩棲類的表表者,在整個非洲大陸的水道、河流和湖泊中都有其蹤影,亦包括南非夸祖魯納塔爾省的壯麗荒野.這兩個物種共存數千年,以不同的方式進化成依水而生.

The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africas amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent, including the stunning wilderness of Kwa-Zulu Natal in South Africa. These two species have co-existed ...

Tusker: Brotherhood of Elephants
programme.desc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象:克雷格、帕斯卡與以掃.深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言、複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結.

programme.title: 征戰火焰山 #2
Volcanic Odysseys 1 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探訪喀拉喀托之子火山(Anak Krakatoa),當它進入劇烈活躍階段時.這座火山被稱為「火之子」,它是喀拉喀托火山的後代,而喀拉喀托火山以現代史上最大規模的噴發而聞名.它的後代是否會重演同樣的模式?

Visit Anak Krakatoa as it enters a violent phase. Known as The Child of Fire, this volcano is an ancestor of Krakatoa, a volcano known for the largest eruption in modern history. Will its descendant repeat the pattern?

programme.title: 月球野性面 #3
Wild Side of the Moon 1 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​展開由月球力量引導的史詩般的旅程.看看無形的信號如何指引鯨魚和海龜沿著海洋遷徙路線,與夜鷹鳥一起穿越大陸,並觀察糞甲蟲及其他依靠月光導航的昆蟲.

Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight.

programme.title: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #1
The Kimberley: Australias Wild West 1 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與小袋鼠一起躲避長滿鱗片與覆滿羽毛的危險威脅,觀察庫拉馬那蜥蜴為了爭奪配偶而激烈交戰,並與剛孵化的鱷魚幼體一同進食.在雨季來臨之際,勇闖危險的急流,理解一條在地河流在文化層面與生物層面上的重要意義.

Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives.

programme.title: 大貓九命 #2
Big Cats: Nine Lives 1 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與一隻小小的幼獅一起在森林中穿行,觀看年輕的成年獅如何宣示自己的領土,並見證年老獵人的不可避免的流亡.發現本能和潛行如何幫助老虎在它孤獨的世界中生存,在這裡每一個決定都充滿風險.

Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

programme.title: 超獸 #5
Superbeast 1 #5
programme.desc: 向大自然中最古老、最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.

Bow down to one of natures most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

programme.title: 超獸 #6
Superbeast 1 #6
programme.desc: 跟著各式各樣的鯊魚在海洋中巡游,看看為什麼這些掠食性魚類能夠稱霸海底世界.和礁鯊一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宮之中,和鬚鯊一起潛伏等待最完美的攻擊時機,並和大白鯊一起展開史詩般的大遷徙.

Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

programme.title: 紮根 #1
Rooted 1 #1
programme.desc: 在喀拉哈里南部的草原上,有一棵壯麗的駱駝刺樹.這棵相思樹已經在此屹立了兩個世紀.在這片乾旱的地貌中,這棵駱駝刺樹是大大小小生物的避難所.善於交際的織布鳥、綠豆象甲蟲和各種哺乳類動物在喀拉哈里活用這棵標誌性的樹.

Across rippled dunes, in the wind-swept grasslands of the southern Kalahari towers a magnificent Camelthorn. It has stood here for two centuries. This tree is never lonely, learn how it provides food, shelter and a hunting ground to many creatures.

programme.title: 尚比亞野生故事 #5
Tales from Zambia 2 #5
programme.desc: 尚比亞的盧安瓜谷是非洲最大和最可怕的巨人的家園,但真正讓它變得特別的是鳥類.這裡有超過400種不同的物種;每個都完美地適應利用所提供的每個機會.

Zambias Luangwa Valley is home to Africas biggest and most fearsome giants, but what really makes it special are its birds. There are over 400 different species here; each perfectly adapted to exploit every opportunity on offer.

Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives.

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #6 [英/普]
Wildlife Icons 2 #6 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 尼羅鱷和河馬是非洲兩種淡水兩棲類的表表者,在整個非洲大陸的水道、河流和湖泊中都有其蹤影,亦包括南非夸祖魯納塔爾省的壯麗荒野.這兩個物種共存數千年,以不同的方式進化成依水而生.

The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africas amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent, including the stunning wilderness of Kwa-Zulu Natal in South Africa. These two species have co-existed ...

programme.title: 超獸 #5
Superbeast 1 #5
programme.desc: 向大自然中最古老、最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.

Bow down to one of natures most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

programme.title: 超獸 #6
Superbeast 1 #6
programme.desc: 跟著各式各樣的鯊魚在海洋中巡游,看看為什麼這些掠食性魚類能夠稱霸海底世界.和礁鯊一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宮之中,和鬚鯊一起潛伏等待最完美的攻擊時機,並和大白鯊一起展開史詩般的大遷徙.

Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

programme.title: 征戰火焰山 #3
Volcanic Odysseys 1 #3
programme.desc: 意大利的埃特納火山是對火山觀測者來說最好的地方之一,火山學家湯菲佛希望幸運地看到陣發性爆發,那是一次短暫而強烈的噴發,會產生壯觀的熔岩噴泉.

Italys Mount Etna is one of the best places for volcano watchers and volcanologist Tom Pfeffier is hoping to get lucky and see a paroxysmal eruption, a short and very intense eruption that produces spectacular lava fountains.

programme.title: 大貓九命 #3
Big Cats: Nine Lives 1 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在嚴酷的環境和不斷的挑戰中奮戰,看看豹子如何不斷智勝敵人以獲取食物並保護幼崽.穿越冰冷的山峰和乾燥的河床,在這裡任何的遭遇都可能改變這隻貓的命運,無論是好是壞.

Battle harsh environments and relentless challenges and see how the leopard constantly outthinks its enemies to secure food and protect its young. Cross icy peaks and arid riverbeds, where any encounter can change this cats fate for better or worse.

programme.title: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #3
Ningaloo: Australias Ocean Wonder 1 #3
programme.desc: 了解寧格魯的保護性奇跡如何激勵人類幫助地球擺脫氣候破壞的影響.參觀廢棄的捕鯨站與其他遺跡,這些都表明只要我們擁有改變的決心,我們就會有改變的工具.

Learn how Ningaloos conservation miracle could inspire humans to pull the planet back from the brink of climatic destruction. Visit an abandoned whaling station and other ruins that show we have the tools, if only we can find the will to change.

programme.title: 顛沛流離亞馬遜 #1
Surviving the Amazon 1 #1
programme.desc: 亞馬遜熱帶雨林中,擁有致命力量的掠食者正在捕獵.完美的進化 - 誰將獲得勝利?

A jaguar stalks the riverbank. A venomous snake is on the move. A Colombian tarantula waits for night fall. Watch as these fierce predators prowl through the jungle and bite into their next great meal.

programme.title: 紮根 #2
Rooted 1 #2
programme.desc: 這是備受喜愛的香腸樹的浪漫故事.博茨瓦納東北角的塞林達保護區面臨艱難的一年.它十分乾旱,雨季還有幾個月才來到.在如此具有挑戰性的期間,許多鳥類和動物依靠香腸樹來維持生計.

Discover the story of the much loved Sausage Tree, whose nectar filled blooms and sausage shaped fruits entice animals of all kinds, from insects to elephants. See how the very animals who rely on this generous tree ensure its proliferation.

programme.title: 尚比亞野生故事 #6
Tales from Zambia 2 #6
programme.desc: 非洲是一個充滿獨特和非凡生物的大陸,牠們經歷數百萬年的進化所塑造.非洲也是人類的發源地,在自我進化之旅中,我們也跟非洲大陸的動物同行,但智慧帶領我們走了一條完全不同的道路.我們的好奇心使我們對周圍的世界充滿疑問,這些問題通過故事、神話和傳說得到了解答.

Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continents animals on our own journey of evolutio...

programme.title: 巨象同盟:長牙兄弟情
Tusker: Brotherhood of Elephants
programme.desc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象:克雷格、帕斯卡與以掃.深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言、複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結.

Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the worlds largest land mammal.

Volcanic Odysseys 1 #4
programme.desc: 夏威夷島上人氣最高的旅遊景點是一座名為基拉韋亞的火山.在火山口板層突然倒塌後,一場大規模的火山爆發使熔岩枯竭,所以現在的基拉韋亞火山變得穩定,讓地質學家菲臘翁終於有機會探索它.

The number one tourist attraction on the island of Hawaii is a volcano called Kilauea. After a sudden collapse of the crater floor, a massive eruption drains the volcano of lava and now Kilauea is silent. Geologist Phillip Ong finally has his chan...

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #1
Snow Leopards with Dan ONeill 1 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與丹一同踏上旅程,穿越嚴酷無情的蒙古荒野,只為尋找那隻史上有紀錄以來體型最大的雪豹:「老兄」(The Dude).目睹他如何在充滿敵意、危機四伏的地形與環境中奮力前行,並在未知與不確定中披荊斬棘,同時揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面臨的艱難挑戰與嚴峻現實.

Navigate the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan as he searches for The Dude, the largest snow leopard ever recorded. Watch him battle hostile landscapes and uncertainty as he sheds light on the challenges that The Dude and other snow leopards face.

programme.title: 奇異地球 #5 [英/普]
Planet Weird 1 #5 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 一窺大自然中最兇猛的鬥士,牠們以暴力來爭奪所需.觀看肉食的波爾夏蜘蛛如何吞噬對手,揭開可愛無尾熊的嗜血一面,並捲入長頸鹿之間一場激烈的頸項對決.

Step into the ring with natures top brawlers, who use violence to get what they need. Watch the cannibalistic Portia spider devour the competition, uncover the bloodthirsty side of cuddly koalas, and catch an epic neck-whipping giraffe battle.

programme.title: 奇異地球 #6 [英/普]
Planet Weird 1 #6 [Eng/Man]

Snow Leopards with Dan ONeill 1 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探、追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵、更具影響力.當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰.

Sniff around The Dudes territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

programme.title: 動物知心友 #5
My Best Friends An Animal 2 #5
programme.desc: 一起去看看樹懶艾莎的近況.佩德羅把自己的人生奉獻給照顧牠,因為牠在一次墜落意外後癱瘓了.了解為什麼狼索爾願意讓牠的人類夥伴史提夫加入自己的族群,接著再看看克莉絲汀和博如何讓浣熊水晶的生活變得更加方便自在.

Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed. Learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

programme.title: 動物知心友 #6
My Best Friends An Animal 2 #6
programme.desc: 跟水獺奧茲以及他的教練萊絲莉一起學習游泳,接著看看佩特羅內爾如何贏得犀牛孤兒莉莉的信任,牠曾因偷獵者而受到創傷.和老鼠科比一起嗅出地雷,並和雙髻鯊蓋婭一起自由潛水.

Learn to swim with Ozzy the otter and his coach, Leslie, then see how Petronel has earned the trust of Riri the rhino orphan, who was traumatized by poachers. Sniff out land mines with Kobe the rat and free-dive with Gaia the hammerhead shark.

The Namaqua Rock Fig Tree stands rooted on the slope of a rocky hill in Namaqualand, South Africa. It is the ultimate survivor, able to withstand the unforgiving conditions in a landscape facing ever rising temperatures and less and less rainfall ...

programme.title: 尚比亞野生故事 #8
Tales from Zambia 2 #8
programme.desc: 樹木是非洲最古老的居民,每棵樹木都有自己在旱季生存的戰略.臘腸樹和無花果樹在季節性極端情況下,向掙扎求存的動物提供食物和住所,共度時艱.作為回報,動物通過幫花卉授粉和分散種子來幫助這些樹木繁殖.非洲樹木促進生命,並成為地球上最珍貴生態系統之一的支柱.

programme.desc: 樹木是非洲最古老的居民,每棵樹木都有自己在旱季生存的戰略.臘腸樹和無花果樹在季節性極端情況下,向掙扎求存的動物提供食物和住所,共度時艱.作為回報,動物通過幫花卉授粉和分散種子來幫助這些樹木繁殖.非洲樹木促進生命,並成為地球上最珍貴生態系統之一的支柱.

Trees are Africas oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals ...

programme.title: 奇異地球 #5 [英/普]
Planet Weird 1 #5 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 一窺大自然中最兇猛的鬥士,牠們以暴力來爭奪所需.觀看肉食的波爾夏蜘蛛如何吞噬對手,揭開可愛無尾熊的嗜血一面,並捲入長頸鹿之間一場激烈的頸項對決.

Step into the ring with natures top brawlers, who use violence to get what they need. Watch the cannibalistic Portia spider devour the competition, uncover the bloodthirsty side of cuddly koalas, and catch an epic neck-whipping giraffe battle.

programme.title: 奇異地球 #6 [英/普]
Planet Weird 1 #6 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 深入暸解地球上最強悍的動物幫派,見證野外求生的真正力量.追蹤一群獵食中的蝗蟲,觀察邊蛸如何埋伏獵物,並拜會一群已培養出嗜血習性的雀鳥.

Get inside the toughest gangs that roam the Earth and see what true grit looks like in the wild. Chase a band of marauding locusts, watch the coconut octopus ambush its next meal, and meet a flock of finches whove developed a taste for blood.

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #2
Snow Leopards with Dan ONeill 1 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探、追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵、更具影響力.當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰.

Sniff around The Dudes territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

programme.title: 動物知心友 #5
My Best Friends An Animal 2 #5
programme.desc: 一起去看看樹懶艾莎的近況.佩德羅把自己的人生奉獻給照顧牠,因為牠在一次墜落意外後癱瘓了.了解為什麼狼索爾願意讓牠的人類夥伴史提夫加入自己的族群,接著再看看克莉絲汀和博如何讓浣熊水晶的生活變得更加方便自在.

Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed. Learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

programme.title: 動物知心友 #6
My Best Friends An Animal 2 #6
programme.desc: 跟水獺奧茲以及他的教練萊絲莉一起學習游泳,接著看看佩特羅內爾如何贏得犀牛孤兒莉莉的信任,牠曾因偷獵者而受到創傷.和老鼠科比一起嗅出地雷,並和雙髻鯊蓋婭一起自由潛水.

Learn to swim with Ozzy the otter and his coach, Leslie, then see how Petronel has earned the trust of Riri the rhino orphan, who was traumatized by poachers. Sniff out land mines with Kobe the rat and free-dive with Gaia the hammerhead shark.

programme.title: 紮根 #4
Rooted 1 #4
programme.desc: 納馬夸岩無花果樹紮根於南非納馬夸蘭的岩石山坡上.它是最終的倖存者,能夠承受每年不斷上升的溫度和越來越少的降雨量這等無情的環境.

The Namaqua Rock Fig Tree stands rooted on the slope of a rocky hill in Namaqualand, South Africa. It is the ultimate survivor, able to withstand the unforgiving conditions in a landscape facing ever rising temperatures and less and less rainfall ...

programme.title: 啄木鳥:樹洞故事
Woodpeckers: The Hole Story
programme.desc: 伴隨著一個獨特的鳥類家族的穩定鼓點行進.了解為何世界上從大到小的239種啄木鳥都是自然界最好的伐木工;探索牠們的飛行、攀爬和呼叫技能;進入牠們的秘密巢穴一探究竟.

March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the worlds 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are natures best lumberjacks; explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills; and get a look inside their secret nests.

programme.title: 動物知心友 #3
My Best Friends An Animal 2 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.

Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

programme.title: 動物知心友 #4
My Best Friends An Animal 2 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​為家養驢凱許的生日慶祝,接著與臭鼬米爾頓玩捉迷藏.認識海狸比約納,他有一份非常重要的工作,並與樹袋鼠班特利及他的人類媽媽一起探索擁抱與午睡的重要性.

Celebrate Cash the house donkeys birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

programme.title: 鯊魚小隊 #3 [英/普]
Shark Squad 1 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 海中最快的魚,尖吻鯖鯊通常是恆溫的,這使牠具有敏捷思維以及驚人速度的優勢.跟隨這種紐西蘭海岸附近相對未被研究的品種.

In some of the most-remote regions on the planet, researchers dive deep and brave danger to unlock secret shark behaviours, challenge myths about sharks, and fight for the protection of these supreme predators – before its too late.

programme.title: 尚比亞野生故事 #3
Tales from Zambia 2 #3
programme.desc: 每天在盧安瓜谷都會看到一具動物屍體.每一具都擁有導致牠們死亡的故事.在草原狩獵鑑證科中,我們調查已發現的3具屍體的死亡個案...
Everyday in the Luangwa Valley a carcass is sighted. Each body holds the story that lead them to their death. In Safari CSI we investigate what killed three carcasses that have been uncovered...

programme.title: 奇異地球 #3 [英/普]
Planet Weird 1 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 拜會自然界中最受關注的物種,暸解為何最壞的伙伴並未得到應有的尊重.看看大白鯊的電力感應器、枯葉螳螂的鋒利肢體、以及蟲草菌煉成「殭屍」的能力.

Meet natures most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad dont get the respect they deserve. Admire the great white sharks electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis, and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi.

programme.title: 奇異地球 #4 [英/普]
Planet Weird 1 #4 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 窺探確保物種在野外互利共生的奇特聯盟.探索小丑魚和海葵之間的夥伴關係,觀察牛椋鳥如何保持草原居民的健康,並揭開糞金龜和豬籠草之間的互利關係.

Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants.

programme.title: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #3
The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #3
programme.desc: 挑戰者一一提起精神,因為十月的寒流使局面變得更加複雜.看看大男孩在絆倒後如何重新振作,然後見證悲劇降臨四子之母.為粉絲最愛的新手媽媽和她的黏人的小孩加油.挑戰來到尾聲,誰會成為最終的皇者?

Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

Big Cats, Small World 1 #1 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 在戈莫提河迎接春天的來臨,豹媽媽費芙和獅媽媽莎芭正在教導她們的幼寶寶如何在危機四伏的野外求存,並讓他們遠離成年雄性的威脅.看看獅王莫雷洛如何戰鬥,獵豹森娜蒂亞則試圖在戰場上證明自己的地位.

Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​為家養驢凱許的生日慶祝,接著與臭鼬米爾頓玩捉迷藏.認識海狸比約納,他有一份非常重要的工作,並與樹袋鼠班特利及他的人類媽媽一起探索擁抱與午睡的重要性.

Celebrate Cash the house donkeys birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

programme.title: 進化的奧秘 #5
Mysteries of Evolution 1 #5
programme.desc: 世上有多種合作形式.一些動物合作群居,而另一些動物則將群體利益置於自身的繁殖潛力之上.看看物種為了生存而進化成互相合作的眾多方式.

Cooperation comes in many forms. Some animals cooperate to be social while others put the welfare of the group above their own reproductive potential. See the many ways species have evolved to work with one another in order to survive.

programme.title: 動物知心友 #3
My Best Friends An Animal 2 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.

Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

programme.title: 動物知心友 #4
My Best Friends An Animal 2 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​為家養驢凱許的生日慶祝,接著與臭鼬米爾頓玩捉迷藏.認識海狸比約納,他有一份非常重要的工作,並與樹袋鼠班特利及他的人類媽媽一起探索擁抱與午睡的重要性.

Celebrate Cash the house donkeys birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

programme.title: 大貓小世界 #2 [英/普]
Big Cats, Small World 1 #2 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 緊貼莫雷洛獅群的行蹤;當冬季洪水到來時,他們因照顧幼獅而精疲力盡.見證獵豹幼寶寶如何作出艱難的決定,並目擊豹媽媽塞菲麗在經歷一場可怕的遭遇後,如何在自己家族與幼寶寶之間作出抉擇.

Track Molelos pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

programme.title: 月球野性面 #1
Wild Side of the Moon 1 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.

Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: 月球野性面 #2
Wild Side of the Moon 1 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​造訪星空下浪漫與冒險的世界.愛上鼠尾草雞的求偶舞蹈,看到一對北極狐情侶重聚,在珊瑚礁中漂浮於產卵魚之間,並參觀鐵匠樹蛙在月光下的繁殖池.

Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: 鯊魚小隊 #4 [英/普]
Shark Squad 1 #4 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 鯊魚經常被描繪成容易攻擊人類的無腦進食機器,但是它們的行為比之前所認為的更加複雜和聰明.找出這些優雅的頂級捕食者如何互動,選擇朋友,甚至訓導其他同類.

Often portrayed as mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans, sharks are more complex and intelligent than previously thought. Find out how these graceful top predators interact, choose friends, and even teach other sharks.

programme.title: 尚比亞野生故事 #4
Tales from Zambia 2 #4
programme.desc: 尚比亞擁有三個非常特殊和不同的非洲伊甸園.位於低處又炎熱的是盧安瓜河谷,高處又乾旱的是柳瓦平原,而涼爽濕潤的是卡桑卡國家公園.這些特質由它們的所在和季節所塑造,每個地方都為選擇於那定居的野生動物提供獨特的東西.

programme.title: 致命奇襲 [英/普]
In for the Kill [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 這是自然界中最具戲劇性的事件之一. 捕食者殺戮獵物時,血肉橫飛,塵土飛揚,爪子和牙齒都染紅.不過大自然的殺戮機器是如何實現這種史詩式的速度、狡猾和敏捷?

Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home.

programme.title: 進化的奧秘 #6
Mysteries of Evolution 1 #6
programme.desc: 有人稱牠們為「活化石」,但這只是對倖存者的另一個稱呼.從鯊魚到鱟,這些動物的早期適應都十分成功,讓牠們數百萬年來相對地保持不變.

Some call them living fossils, but thats just another way to say survivors. From the shark to the horseshoe crab, these animals early adaptations were a success, leaving them relatively unchanged for millions of years.

programme.title: 動物玩學誌 #1
Animals at Play 1 #1
programme.desc: 在大自然中,年幼的動物大部分時間都在玩耍.從喜歡追逐的貓,到可以解決謎題的黑猩猩.新研究表明遊戲幾乎是動物學習的全部核心,它不僅是樂趣和遊戲.

Explore the ways that animals use play, including young gibbons in Thailand that practice falling from branches, elderly macaques that preserve their brains with playtime, and games that sharpen the profound intelligence of African elephants.

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #1
Great Parks of Africa 2 #1
programme.desc: 在海陸相連的公園中,自然元素相互結合,創造出美妙的多樣性.可樂色的水使森林變得翠綠和茂密.火與風促進多樣性的增長,岩石形成了眾多面貌的海岸線.生命在這裡茁壯成長 - 從壯麗到奇異,這是花園大道國家公園.

In a park where land meets sea, the natural elements combine to create wonderful variety. Cola-colored water feeds forests green and dense. Fire and wind fuel growth in great diversity and rock shapes a coastline of many faces. Life thrives here -...

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #2
Great Parks of Africa 2 #2
programme.desc: 在克留格爾國家公園北部,賴以維生的元素就是水.在炎熱和乾旱的土地上,一條絲帶在荒野中切割出可靠的路線.它是不論大小所有生物的生命線.

In the northern reaches of the Kruger National Park, life depends on one thing – water. In a land burdened by heat and drought a single ribbon cuts its reliable course through the wilderness. Its a lifeline to all creatures, great and small.

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #3
Great Parks of Africa 2 #3
programme.desc: 偉大的奧蘭治河有著56米高壯觀的奧赫拉比斯瀑布.奧赫拉比斯源於「oukurubes」這個詞,在南瑪改的土著語言中意思是「雷霆之地」,這片土地是一個苛刻和陽光充沛世界的中心,充滿絢麗色彩和雷鳴般的咆哮.

Augrabies is where the mighty Orange River plunges over the awesome 56 meter Augrabies waterfall. Derived from a word oukurubes which means place of thunder in the indigenous language of the Nama-Khoi this land is the heart of a harsh and sun-...

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #4
Great Parks of Africa 2 #4
programme.desc: 地球上從最小到最大的任何生物都離不開食物、水和住所,沿著非洲最大河流之一的河岸,一些動物極力求生,而另一些則茁壯成長.所有動物都為尋找生存所需展開旅程,牠們必須決定在何時何地移動來獲取成功...這就是贊比西河下游的神奇世界.

Food, water and shelter are essential to all life on earth from the smallest of beings to the largest, and along the banks of one of Africas greatest rivers, some animals struggle while others thrive. A rhythm drives all animals as they journey i...

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #5
Great Parks of Africa 2 #5
programme.desc: 在南非祖魯蘭中心地帶,有著非洲大陸最古老的野生動物保護區 - 赫盧赫盧韋 - 烏姆福洛濟禁獵區.南方白犀牛在動盪時期於此找到了保護.在19世紀末幾乎因為被捕獵而完全滅絕,公園的建立為犀牛提供了一條生路 - 讓牠們從絕種中恢復過來.

In the heart of Zululand, South Africa, lies the oldest game reserve on the African continent – Hluhluwe-iMfolozi. Here, Southern white rhinos have found protection from people in times of turmoil. Hunted almost to extinction at the end of the 19t...

programme.title: 海灘「龜」來記
Turtle Beach
programme.desc: 當成千上萬的海龜日以繼夜登上哥斯達黎加的海灘生下數以百萬計的蛋,當地人稱之為「到達」.本節目滿是新發現,加拿大自然學家及攝影師胡戈基奇跟隨一隊國際科學家團隊進行創新性的科學考察,以解開這個稀有現象的謎底.
Locals call it the arribada, or arrival. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #3
Wild Latin America 1 #3
programme.desc: 在秘魯的山脈,一小群眼鏡熊為生存而戰.孤兒阿馬遜娜必須學會獨立.老去的東哥沒時間找到配偶,很難才能俘虜理想對象曹莉達.
Get to know South Americas only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru.

programme.title: 鯊魚小隊 #1 [英/普]
Shark Squad 1 #1 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 在墨西哥瓜達盧普島附近,頂尖鯊魚生態學家莫利斯奧許尤士先使用遙視.他將攝影機安裝在大白鯊的鰭上,拍攝到一個獨特的視野,揭示牠如何游泳、狩獵,並且最終襲擊獵物.

Off Guadalupe Island, Mexico, top shark ecologist Mauricio Hoyos attempts a television first. Get a unique view as he attaches a camera to the dorsal fin of a great white, revealing how it swims, hunts, and ultimately strikes its prey.

programme.title: 鯊魚小隊 #2 [英/普]
Shark Squad 1 #2 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 前往巴哈馬的偏遠地區,解開鯊魚的秘密.牠們交友嗎?牠們在哪裡生育?有品種比其他大膽嗎?答案可能有助保護這些至高無上掠食者的後代.

Travel to a remote part of the Bahamas to unlock shark secrets. Do they make friends? Where do they give birth? Are some bolder than others? The answers may help protect these supreme predators for generations to come.

programme.title: 鯊魚小隊 #3 [英/普]
Shark Squad 1 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 海中最快的魚,尖吻鯖鯊通常是恆溫的,這使牠具有敏捷思維以及驚人速度的優勢.跟隨這種紐西蘭海岸附近相對未被研究的品種.

In some of the most-remote regions on the planet, researchers dive deep and brave danger to unlock secret shark behaviours, challenge myths about sharks, and fight for the protection of these supreme predators – before its too late.

programme.title: 鯊魚小隊 #4 [英/普]
Shark Squad 1 #4 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 鯊魚經常被描繪成容易攻擊人類的無腦進食機器,但是它們的行為比之前所認為的更加複雜和聰明.找出這些優雅的頂級捕食者如何互動,選擇朋友,甚至訓導其他同類.

Often portrayed as mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans, sharks are more complex and intelligent than previously thought. Find out how these graceful top predators interact, choose friends, and even teach other sharks.

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #3 [英/普]
Chasing the Rains 1 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 跟隨阿納斯塔西亞的足跡,牠的象群因為保護兩隻珍貴的小象而兵分兩路,而獵豹庫萊塔則為牠剩下的幼崽奪回領地.塵土散去,雨水開始滋潤乾涸的大地,加入野狗菲尼克斯尋找新伴侶的旅程.

Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenixs search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land.

programme.title: 大貓九命 #1
Big Cats: Nine Lives 1 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​描繪獅子生命的九個階段,從無助的小獅子到自信的成年獅,再到年老的流亡者.看看競爭、飢餓和驕傲的動態如何塑造它在塞倫蓋提的生活,並見證使這種社交貓獨特的忠誠和合作精神.

Chart the lions nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

programme.title: 大貓九命 #2
Big Cats: Nine Lives 1 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與一隻小小的幼獅一起在森林中穿行,觀看年輕的成年獅如何宣示自己的領土,並見證年老獵人的不可避免的流亡.發現本能和潛行如何幫助老虎在它孤獨的世界中生存,在這裡每一個決定都充滿風險.

Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

programme.title: 大貓九命 #3
Big Cats: Nine Lives 1 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在嚴酷的環境和不斷的挑戰中奮戰,看看豹子如何不斷智勝敵人以獲取食物並保護幼崽.穿越冰冷的山峰和乾燥的河床,在這裡任何的遭遇都可能改變這隻貓的命運,無論是好是壞.

Battle harsh environments and relentless challenges and see how the leopard constantly outthinks its enemies to secure food and protect its young. Cross icy peaks and arid riverbeds, where any encounter can change this cats fate for better or worse.

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #1
Snow Leopards with Dan ONeill 1 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與丹一同踏上旅程,穿越嚴酷無情的蒙古荒野,只為尋找那隻史上有紀錄以來體型最大的雪豹:「老兄」(The Dude).目睹他如何在充滿敵意、危機四伏的地形與環境中奮力前行,並在未知與不確定中披荊斬棘,同時揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面臨的艱難挑戰與嚴峻現實.

Navigate the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan as he searches for The Dude, the largest snow leopard ever recorded. Watch him battle hostile landscapes and uncertainty as he sheds light on the challenges that The Dude and other snow leopards face.

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #2
Snow Leopards with Dan ONeill 1 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探、追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵、更具影響力.當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰.

Sniff around The Dudes territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #1
Africas Hunters 1 #1
programme.desc: 本集跟隨一隻老邁的豹子三天,她正努力覓食,同時試圖避開惡魔般的鄰居:一個清道夫獅子群.

A revolutionary thermal camera reveals the secret world of nocturnal predators. Follow along as one of the oldest-known leopards struggles to survive her fearsome neighbors: a pride of scavenging lions.

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #3 [英/普]
Chasing the Rains 1 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 跟隨阿納斯塔西亞的足跡,牠的象群因為保護兩隻珍貴的小象而兵分兩路,而獵豹庫萊塔則為牠剩下的幼崽奪回領地.塵土散去,雨水開始滋潤乾涸的大地,加入野狗菲尼克斯尋找新伴侶的旅程.

Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenixs search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land.

A revolutionary thermal camera reveals the secret world of nocturnal predators. Follow along as one of the oldest-known leopards struggles to survive her fearsome neighbors: a pride of scavenging lions.

programme.title: 征戰火焰山 #1
Volcanic Odysseys 1 #1
programme.desc: 埃塞俄比亞的達納基勒窪地不僅是地球上最不適合居住的地方之一,而且是地質活動最活躍的地區之一.火山學家湯菲佛正帶著一群冒險的遊客穿過達納基勒去看爾塔阿雷火山.

The Danakil Depression in Ethiopia is not only one of the most inhospitable places on Earth, but is one of the most geologically active. Now, volcanologist Tom Pfeiffer is taking a group of adventure tourists to cross the Danakil to see the Erte A...

programme.title: 動物玩學誌 #2
Animals at Play 1 #2
programme.desc: 世界各地的動物會玩各種團體遊戲,從玩扯大纜的年輕鬣狗,到喜歡混戰的淘氣猴子.但為甚麼有些動物需要跟同伴一起玩耍呢?遊戲的規則又是甚麼呢?

Young hyenas compete in tug of war, mischievous parrots play at picking apart tourists cars, and Atlantic spotted dolphins enjoy sophisticated social games amid seaweed—all following specific rules that hone social bonds.

programme.title: 極限非洲 #1
Extreme Africa 1 #1
programme.desc: 南非的龍山是其中一處擁有大陸上最壯麗美景的地方.它的氣候和生態梯度急劇變化,亦影響著陸空生物和天上猛禽的生活環境.

South Africas Drakensberg is one of the continents most impressive landscapes. It is home to sharp climatic and ecological gradients as physical conditions change for both land-based creatures and the Raptors that swirl in the skies above.

programme.title: 極限非洲 #2
Extreme Africa 1 #2
programme.desc: 在坦桑尼亞北部,高聳的山脈形成一個巨大的山谷.它被古老的火山所滋養,坡道為生命提供了多元化的棲息地,而它巨大的重心地帶即使在最乾燥的時期也能保存水源.

In north Tanzania, towering mountains line a dramatic valley. Enriched by ancient volcanoes, its slopes provide a variety of habitats for life to thrive and its great centerpiece holds water through even the driest of times.

programme.title: 極限非洲 #3
Extreme Africa 1 #3
programme.desc: 埃塞俄比亞的塞米恩國家公園住著地球上一些最稀有的生物.窺探非洲最高峰的生活,那是在草原遊走毛茸茸的獅尾狒、神出鬼沒的塞米恩狼和有角的瓦利亞野山羊的最後堡壘.

Simien Mountains National Park in Ethiopia is home to some of the rarest creatures on earth. Take a glimpse into life on some of the highest peaks in Africa, in the last stronghold of shaggy, grass-grazing Geladas, elusive Simien wolves and horned...

programme.title: 極限非洲 #4
Extreme Africa 1 #4
programme.desc: 進入南部旱地是一趟非洲南部最遠端、最乾旱和極端環境的旅程.我們到訪了幾乎不降雨,既壯觀又危險的地方,為了尋找適應力極強的動物,並了解牠們生存的秘密.從最大的哺乳類到最敏捷的昆蟲,甚至是世上僅有幽靈般的魚類,南部旱地擁有非凡的居民,生活在世上其中一處最荒涼的棲息地接受日常挑戰,牠們都站在同一陣線.

The Southern Drylands is a journey into the most arid and extreme environments in the furthest reaches of southern Africa. We go to spectacular but treacherous places where almost no rain falls, to find incredibly resilient creatures and learn the...

programme.title: 極限非洲 #5
Extreme Africa 1 #5
programme.desc: 現已乾涸的埃托沙曾是一個大湖,現在只有夏季降雨期間才能季節性地補充水分.但當埃托沙充滿水時,無數的水鳥就會聚集在淺湖中繁殖,最常見的是大小紅鸛.

Etosha was once a great lake that dried up and now only fills with water seasonally during the summer rains. Once the Etosha pan is full of water, a myriad of water birds congregate in the shallow lake to breed, most notably Greater and lesser fla...

programme.title: 極限非洲 #6
Extreme Africa 1 #6
programme.desc: 沿著南非的奧蘭治河,從它的源頭到大西洋出海處.我們在沿途能遇到各樣的棲息地和當中的生物,從理察斯維德的旱地到奧赫拉比斯的美景; 這是一個線形綠洲的故事.我們將揭示生物如何適應其河道,並發現豐富的動植物世界.

Follow the course of South Africas Orange river from its origins to where it spills out into the Atlantic Ocean. Along the way we encounter a diverse range of habitats and the creatures they support, from the dry lands of the Richtersveld to the ...

programme.title: 「礁」來船禍 #5
Reef Wrecks 1 #5
programme.desc: 從機會主義的海盜船到裝備精良的海軍艦艇,墨西哥的尤卡坦半島沉浸在海事的歷史中.
From opportunistic pirate ships, to well-armed navy vessels, Mexicos Yucatan Peninsula is steeped in maritime history.

programme.title: 尚比亞野生故事 #1
Tales from Zambia 2 #1
programme.desc: 在這片小林地中,兩隻幼猴面臨一生中最艱難的日子.牠們要在世上找到一席之地時,必須瞭解哪些鄰居是盟友,哪些是敵人;誰值得信賴,誰應該避開.牠們會失去或得到朋友,這樣才算是林地的一份子.

In this small patch of woodland, two young monkeys face the toughest time of their lives. As they find their place in the world, they must learn which neighbors are allies, and which are foes. Who to trust, and who to avoid. They will suffer loss,...

programme.title: 尚比亞野生故事 #2
Tales from Zambia 2 #2
programme.desc: 尚比亞的荒野是一個難以生存的地方.這裡許多動物都必須成群結隊來幫忙保衛領土、保護後代、覓食和對抗掠食者.
The wilds of Zambia are a tough place to live. Here, many animals must come together in groups to help defend territory, protect offspring, find food and overcome predators.

programme.title: 尚比亞野生故事 #3
Tales from Zambia 2 #3
programme.desc: 每天在盧安瓜谷都會看到一具動物屍體.每一具都擁有導致牠們死亡的故事.在草原狩獵鑑證科中,我們調查已發現的3具屍體的死亡個案...
Everyday in the Luangwa Valley a carcass is sighted. Each body holds the story that lead them to their death. In Safari CSI we investigate what killed three carcasses that have been uncovered...

programme.title: 尚比亞野生故事 #4
Tales from Zambia 2 #4
programme.desc: 尚比亞擁有三個非常特殊和不同的非洲伊甸園.位於低處又炎熱的是盧安瓜河谷,高處又乾旱的是柳瓦平原,而涼爽濕潤的是卡桑卡國家公園.這些特質由它們的所在和季節所塑造,每個地方都為選擇於那定居的野生動物提供獨特的東西.

Zambia is home to three very special and different African Edens. The low, hot Luangwa River Valley, the high, dry Liuwa Plain and the cool, wet Kasanka National Park. Defined by the earth on which they sit and shaped by the seasons, each place of...

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #4 [英/普]
Wildlife Icons 2 #4 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 在非洲大草原上生存需要機智和奸狡,特別是兩名獵人:非洲野狗和侏獴.這兩種神秘的物種都是群居,並依靠良好協調的團隊合作來取得成功.從照顧初生之犢到尋找食物和抵禦敵人.牠們都依靠緊密的家庭來克服日常的挑戰.

Surviving the African savanna requires guile and teamwork for species who live in packs. Follow a day in the life of African wild dogs and dwarf mongooses to see how they rely on their tight-knit families to overcome the challenging landscape.

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #5 [英/普]
Wildlife Icons 2 #5 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 一個複雜的關係網絡統治著地球上的所有生命 - 所有物種都相互聯繫,沒有一個能獨善其身.某些關係是單向的,但其他則是互利的.從鬆散的協力到緊密的伙伴關係,一切盡在大自然的偉大計劃之中.物種之間複雜的互動關係甚至不僅限於動物 - 一些最好的例子發生在非洲茂密的山林中.

A complex web of relationships rules all life on earth: all species are interconnected, none can survive in isolation. While some relationships are one-sided, others are mutually beneficial. From loose associations to tight-knit partnerships, ever...

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #6 [英/普]
Wildlife Icons 2 #6 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 尼羅鱷和河馬是非洲兩種淡水兩棲類的表表者,在整個非洲大陸的水道、河流和湖泊中都有其蹤影,亦包括南非夸祖魯納塔爾省的壯麗荒野.這兩個物種共存數千年,以不同的方式進化成依水而生.

The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africas amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent, including the stunning wilderness of Kwa-Zulu Natal in South Africa. These two species have co-existed ...

programme.title: 巨象同盟:長牙兄弟情
Tusker: Brotherhood of Elephants
programme.desc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象:克雷格、帕斯卡與以掃.深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言、複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結.

Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the worlds largest land mammal.

programme.title: 大象傳奇 [英/普]
The Great Elephant Tale [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 《大象傳奇》有三個故事.一頭牛犢穿越奧卡萬戈三角洲.一頭公牛正尋覓伴侶.一位女族長帶領家人穿過沙漠.這些個別的冒險故事一同敍述了非洲最具標誌性物種之一的故事.

Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

programme.title: 啄木鳥:樹洞故事
Woodpeckers: The Hole Story
programme.desc: 伴隨著一個獨特的鳥類家族的穩定鼓點行進.了解為何世界上從大到小的239種啄木鳥都是自然界最好的伐木工;探索牠們的飛行、攀爬和呼叫技能;進入牠們的秘密巢穴一探究竟.

March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the worlds 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are natures best lumberjacks; explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills; and get a look inside their secret nests.

programme.title: 祕「蜜」日記 [英/普]
A Bees Diary [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 在蜂巢內,成千上萬的小動物朝著一個共同目標努力:群體的生存.但是個別蜜蜂的生活又如何?《秘「蜜」日記》講述這個故事.
In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bees Diary tells that story.

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #4 [英/普]
Wildlife Icons 2 #4 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 在非洲大草原上生存需要機智和奸狡,特別是兩名獵人:非洲野狗和侏獴.這兩種神秘的物種都是群居,並依靠良好協調的團隊合作來取得成功.從照顧初生之犢到尋找食物和抵禦敵人.牠們都依靠緊密的家庭來克服日常的挑戰.

Surviving the African savanna requires guile and teamwork for species who live in packs. Follow a day in the life of African wild dogs and dwarf mongooses to see how they rely on their tight-knit families to overcome the challenging landscape.

programme.title: 征戰火焰山 #2
Volcanic Odysseys 1 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探訪喀拉喀托之子火山(Anak Krakatoa),當它進入劇烈活躍階段時.這座火山被稱為「火之子」,它是喀拉喀托火山的後代,而喀拉喀托火山以現代史上最大規模的噴發而聞名.它的後代是否會重演同樣的模式?

Visit Anak Krakatoa as it enters a violent phase. Known as The Child of Fire, this volcano is an ancestor of Krakatoa, a volcano known for the largest eruption in modern history. Will its descendant repeat the pattern?

programme.title: 月球野性面 #3
Wild Side of the Moon 1 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​展開由月球力量引導的史詩般的旅程.看看無形的信號如何指引鯨魚和海龜沿著海洋遷徙路線,與夜鷹鳥一起穿越大陸,並觀察糞甲蟲及其他依靠月光導航的昆蟲.

Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight.

programme.title: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #1
The Kimberley: Australias Wild West 1 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與小袋鼠一起躲避長滿鱗片與覆滿羽毛的危險威脅,觀察庫拉馬那蜥蜴為了爭奪配偶而激烈交戰,並與剛孵化的鱷魚幼體一同進食.在雨季來臨之際,勇闖危險的急流,理解一條在地河流在文化層面與生物層面上的重要意義.

Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives.

programme.title: 大貓九命 #2
Big Cats: Nine Lives 1 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與一隻小小的幼獅一起在森林中穿行,觀看年輕的成年獅如何宣示自己的領土,並見證年老獵人的不可避免的流亡.發現本能和潛行如何幫助老虎在它孤獨的世界中生存,在這裡每一個決定都充滿風險.

Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

programme.title: 超獸 #5
Superbeast 1 #5
programme.desc: 向大自然中最古老、最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.

Bow down to one of natures most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

programme.title: 超獸 #6
Superbeast 1 #6
programme.desc: 跟著各式各樣的鯊魚在海洋中巡游,看看為什麼這些掠食性魚類能夠稱霸海底世界.和礁鯊一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宮之中,和鬚鯊一起潛伏等待最完美的攻擊時機,並和大白鯊一起展開史詩般的大遷徙.

Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

programme.title: 紮根 #1
Rooted 1 #1
programme.desc: 在喀拉哈里南部的草原上,有一棵壯麗的駱駝刺樹.這棵相思樹已經在此屹立了兩個世紀.在這片乾旱的地貌中,這棵駱駝刺樹是大大小小生物的避難所.善於交際的織布鳥、綠豆象甲蟲和各種哺乳類動物在喀拉哈里活用這棵標誌性的樹.

Across rippled dunes, in the wind-swept grasslands of the southern Kalahari towers a magnificent Camelthorn. It has stood here for two centuries. This tree is never lonely, learn how it provides food, shelter and a hunting ground to many creatures.

programme.title: 尚比亞野生故事 #5
Tales from Zambia 2 #5
programme.desc: 尚比亞的盧安瓜谷是非洲最大和最可怕的巨人的家園,但真正讓它變得特別的是鳥類.這裡有超過400種不同的物種;每個都完美地適應利用所提供的每個機會.

Zambias Luangwa Valley is home to Africas biggest and most fearsome giants, but what really makes it special are its birds. There are over 400 different species here; each perfectly adapted to exploit every opportunity on offer.

Zambias Luangwa Valley is home to Africas biggest and most fearsome giants, but what really makes it special are its birds. There are over 400 different species here; each perfectly adapted to exploit every opportunity on offer.

programme.title: 月球野性面 #3
Wild Side of the Moon 1 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​展開由月球力量引導的史詩般的旅程.看看無形的信號如何指引鯨魚和海龜沿著海洋遷徙路線,與夜鷹鳥一起穿越大陸,並觀察糞甲蟲及其他依靠月光導航的昆蟲.

Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight.

programme.title: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #1
The Kimberley: Australias Wild West 1 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與小袋鼠一起躲避長滿鱗片與覆滿羽毛的危險威脅,觀察庫拉馬那蜥蜴為了爭奪配偶而激烈交戰,並與剛孵化的鱷魚幼體一同進食.在雨季來臨之際,勇闖危險的急流,理解一條在地河流在文化層面與生物層面上的重要意義.

Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives.

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #6 [英/普]
Wildlife Icons 2 #6 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 尼羅鱷和河馬是非洲兩種淡水兩棲類的表表者,在整個非洲大陸的水道、河流和湖泊中都有其蹤影,亦包括南非夸祖魯納塔爾省的壯麗荒野.這兩個物種共存數千年,以不同的方式進化成依水而生.

The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africas amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent, including the stunning wilderness of Kwa-Zulu Natal in South Africa. These two species have co-existed ...

programme.title: 超獸 #5
Superbeast 1 #5
programme.desc: 向大自然中最古老、最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.

Bow down to one of natures most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

programme.title: 超獸 #6
Superbeast 1 #6
programme.desc: 跟著各式各樣的鯊魚在海洋中巡游,看看為什麼這些掠食性魚類能夠稱霸海底世界.和礁鯊一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宮之中,和鬚鯊一起潛伏等待最完美的攻擊時機,並和大白鯊一起展開史詩般的大遷徙.

Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

programme.title: 征戰火焰山 #3
Volcanic Odysseys 1 #3
programme.desc: 意大利的埃特納火山是對火山觀測者來說最好的地方之一,火山學家湯菲佛希望幸運地看到陣發性爆發,那是一次短暫而強烈的噴發,會產生壯觀的熔岩噴泉.

Italys Mount Etna is one of the best places for volcano watchers and volcanologist Tom Pfeffier is hoping to get lucky and see a paroxysmal eruption, a short and very intense eruption that produces spectacular lava fountains.

programme.desc: 向大自然中最古老、最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.

programme.title: 大貓九命 #3
Big Cats: Nine Lives 1 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在嚴酷的環境和不斷的挑戰中奮戰,看看豹子如何不斷智勝敵人以獲取食物並保護幼崽.穿越冰冷的山峰和乾燥的河床,在這裡任何的遭遇都可能改變這隻貓的命運,無論是好是壞.

Battle harsh environments and relentless challenges and see how the leopard constantly outthinks its enemies to secure food and protect its young. Cross icy peaks and arid riverbeds, where any encounter can change this cats fate for better or worse.

programme.title: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #3
Ningaloo: Australias Ocean Wonder 1 #3
programme.desc: 了解寧格魯的保護性奇跡如何激勵人類幫助地球擺脫氣候破壞的影響.參觀廢棄的捕鯨站與其他遺跡,這些都表明只要我們擁有改變的決心,我們就會有改變的工具.

Learn how Ningaloos conservation miracle could inspire humans to pull the planet back from the brink of climatic destruction. Visit an abandoned whaling station and other ruins that show we have the tools, if only we can find the will to change.

programme.title: 顛沛流離亞馬遜 #1
Surviving the Amazon 1 #1
programme.desc: 亞馬遜熱帶雨林中,擁有致命力量的掠食者正在捕獵.完美的進化 - 誰將獲得勝利?

A jaguar stalks the riverbank. A venomous snake is on the move. A Colombian tarantula waits for night fall. Watch as these fierce predators prowl through the jungle and bite into their next great meal.

programme.title: 紮根 #2
Rooted 1 #2
programme.desc: 這是備受喜愛的香腸樹的浪漫故事.博茨瓦納東北角的塞林達保護區面臨艱難的一年.它十分乾旱,雨季還有幾個月才來到.在如此具有挑戰性的期間,許多鳥類和動物依靠香腸樹來維持生計.

Discover the story of the much loved Sausage Tree, whose nectar filled blooms and sausage shaped fruits entice animals of all kinds, from insects to elephants. See how the very animals who rely on this generous tree ensure its proliferation.

programme.title: 巨象同盟:長牙兄弟情
Tusker: Brotherhood of Elephants
programme.desc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象:克雷格、帕斯卡與以掃.深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言、複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結.

Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the worlds largest land mammal.

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #1
Snow Leopards with Dan ONeill 1 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與丹一同踏上旅程,穿越嚴酷無情的蒙古荒野,只為尋找那隻史上有紀錄以來體型最大的雪豹:「老兄」(The Dude).目睹他如何在充滿敵意、危機四伏的地形與環境中奮力前行,並在未知與不確定中披荊斬棘,同時揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面臨的艱難挑戰與嚴峻現實.

Navigate the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan as he searches for The Dude, the largest snow leopard ever recorded. Watch him battle hostile landscapes and uncertainty as he sheds light on the challenges that The Dude and other snow leopards face.

Madagascar is home to strange animals not found anywhere else on Earth. When these animals fight for supremacy, their battles are just as strange - from weird neck-wrestling weevils to ring-tailed lemur moms that go into battle with baby on board.

Snow Leopards with Dan ONeill 1 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探、追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵、更具影響力.當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰.

Sniff around The Dudes territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

programme.title: 動物知心友 #5
My Best Friends An Animal 2 #5
programme.desc: 一起去看看樹懶艾莎的近況.佩德羅把自己的人生奉獻給照顧牠,因為牠在一次墜落意外後癱瘓了.了解為什麼狼索爾願意讓牠的人類夥伴史提夫加入自己的族群,接著再看看克莉絲汀和博如何讓浣熊水晶的生活變得更加方便自在.

Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed. Learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

programme.title: 動物知心友 #6
My Best Friends An Animal 2 #6
programme.desc: 跟水獺奧茲以及他的教練萊絲莉一起學習游泳,接著看看佩特羅內爾如何贏得犀牛孤兒莉莉的信任,牠曾因偷獵者而受到創傷.和老鼠科比一起嗅出地雷,並和雙髻鯊蓋婭一起自由潛水.

Learn to swim with Ozzy the otter and his coach, Leslie, then see how Petronel has earned the trust of Riri the rhino orphan, who was traumatized by poachers. Sniff out land mines with Kobe the rat and free-dive with Gaia the hammerhead shark.

programme.title: 紮根 #4
Rooted 1 #4
programme.desc: 納馬夸岩無花果樹紮根於南非納馬夸蘭的岩石山坡上.它是最終的倖存者,能夠承受每年不斷上升的溫度和越來越少的降雨量這等無情的環境.

The Namaqua Rock Fig Tree stands rooted on the slope of a rocky hill in Namaqualand, South Africa. It is the ultimate survivor, able to withstand the unforgiving conditions in a landscape facing ever rising temperatures and less and less rainfall ...

programme.title: 尚比亞野生故事 #8
Tales from Zambia 2 #8
programme.desc: 樹木是非洲最古老的居民,每棵樹木都有自己在旱季生存的戰略.臘腸樹和無花果樹在季節性極端情況下,向掙扎求存的動物提供食物和住所,共度時艱.作為回報,動物通過幫花卉授粉和分散種子來幫助這些樹木繁殖.非洲樹木促進生命,並成為地球上最珍貴生態系統之一的支柱.

Trees are Africas oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals ...

My Best Friends An Animal 2 #6
programme.desc: 跟水獺奧茲以及他的教練萊絲莉一起學習游泳,接著看看佩特羅內爾如何贏得犀牛孤兒莉莉的信任,牠曾因偷獵者而受到創傷.和老鼠科比一起嗅出地雷,並和雙髻鯊蓋婭一起自由潛水.

Learn to swim with Ozzy the otter and his coach, Leslie, then see how Petronel has earned the trust of Riri the rhino orphan, who was traumatized by poachers. Sniff out land mines with Kobe the rat and free-dive with Gaia the hammerhead shark.

programme.title: 紮根 #4
Rooted 1 #4
programme.desc: 納馬夸岩無花果樹紮根於南非納馬夸蘭的岩石山坡上.它是最終的倖存者,能夠承受每年不斷上升的溫度和越來越少的降雨量這等無情的環境.

The Namaqua Rock Fig Tree stands rooted on the slope of a rocky hill in Namaqualand, South Africa. It is the ultimate survivor, able to withstand the unforgiving conditions in a landscape facing ever rising temperatures and less and less rainfall ...

programme.title: 尚比亞野生故事 #8
Tales from Zambia 2 #8
programme.desc: 樹木是非洲最古老的居民,每棵樹木都有自己在旱季生存的戰略.臘腸樹和無花果樹在季節性極端情況下,向掙扎求存的動物提供食物和住所,共度時艱.作為回報,動物通過幫花卉授粉和分散種子來幫助這些樹木繁殖.非洲樹木促進生命,並成為地球上最珍貴生態系統之一的支柱.

Trees are Africas oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals ...

programme.title: 奇異地球 #5 [英/普]
Planet Weird 1 #5 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 一窺大自然中最兇猛的鬥士,牠們以暴力來爭奪所需.觀看肉食的波爾夏蜘蛛如何吞噬對手,揭開可愛無尾熊的嗜血一面,並捲入長頸鹿之間一場激烈的頸項對決.

Step into the ring with natures top brawlers, who use violence to get what they need. Watch the cannibalistic Portia spider devour the competition, uncover the bloodthirsty side of cuddly koalas, and catch an epic neck-whipping giraffe battle.

programme.title: 奇異地球 #6 [英/普]
Planet Weird 1 #6 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 深入暸解地球上最強悍的動物幫派,見證野外求生的真正力量.追蹤一群獵食中的蝗蟲,觀察邊蛸如何埋伏獵物,並拜會一群已培養出嗜血習性的雀鳥.

Get inside the toughest gangs that roam the Earth and see what true grit looks like in the wild. Chase a band of marauding locusts, watch the coconut octopus ambush its next meal, and meet a flock of finches whove developed a taste for blood.

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #2
Snow Leopards with Dan ONeill 1 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探、追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵、更具影響力.當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰.

Sniff around The Dudes territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

Tower of God S2 #18

Radiant S2 #2

Radiant S2 #3

programme.title: 虛空魔境2 #4
Radiant S2 #4

Seth and Ocoho face off against a powerful Spectral Nemesis band while attempting to protect a small farm from destruction.

programme.title: 魔鬼孩子王
Kindergarten Cop

Arnold Schwarzenegger stars as tough detective John Kimble in Kindergarten Cop, going undercover as a teacher to find a drug lords wife. Packed with action, humor, and heart, its a classic comedy-thriller.

programme.title: 美國殺人魔
American Psycho [Extended Version]
programme.desc: 派屈克・貝特曼是一名在華爾街,於父親公司任職的年輕人,卻毫無理由地殺人.隨著日子一天天過去,他對世界的仇恨愈發強烈.這部極度黑暗的黑色喜劇改編自布雷特・伊斯頓・艾利斯的同名小說.

Patrick Bateman, a young man working on Wall Street at his fathers company kills for no reason at all. With each day, his hatred for the world becomes more and more intense. This incredibly dark comedy is based on the book by Bret Easton Ellis.

programme.title: 醉後末日
The Worlds End
programme.desc: 在 醉後末日中,西蒙·佩格與尼克·弗羅斯特再次攜手展開史詩般的酒吧巡禮,卻意外捲入一場關乎人類未來的生死戰.導演埃德加·賴特(Edgar Wright)帶來充滿懷舊情懷,幽默喜劇與科幻刺激元素的獨特觀影體驗.

In The Worlds End, Simon Pegg and Nick Frost reunite for an epic pub crawl that turns into a fight for humanitys future. Director Edgar Wright delivers a hilarious mix of nostalgia, comedy, and sci-fi thrills.

programme.title: 天崩地裂

真情 #539
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #539
programme.desc: 碧琪向女牧師剖白，被潤好於不遠處聽見一切，羞愧萬分，冰雪見碧琪淚流滿面，要求潤好離開，此時碧琪把自己推向斜坡，潤好飛身撲上拉著輪椅，碧琪失重心仰前跌下。在醫院，尚人雖知潤好仍愛自己，但忍痛將錶還給潤好，潤好難過。在回酒店途中本想將錶棄掉，但最終還是不捨，發狂似的在垃圾堆中找回錶，標漢和標炳在不遠處看見一切，標漢知潤好對尚人有情，對自己只有義，故決定讓愛。標漢指潤好與尚人有不道德的行為，怒氣沖沖的往醫院找尚人，揚言不會與潤好結婚，潤好聽後心如刀割，但其實標漢的心裏亦很難受。

programme.title: 真情 #540
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #540
programme.desc: 李家怕潤好會自尋短見，但潤好竟然容光煥發，並謂要重新做人。由於潤好因婚事而買的東西很多也不能用，故李家眾人抽簽分配，阿瓊抽到美容優惠套裝。阿貴、清雲及小梅陪阿瓊到美容院，阿貴請美容師將阿瓊脫胎換骨，阿瓊無奈留在美容院任人擺佈。阿瓊被美容師耍弄一番後，致電回家請人拿回她平日的衣服更換，想做回自己。添福與大勝驚見化了妝的阿瓊，故叫子力去看，還要子力拿相機拍下阿瓊的新形象。子力見到阿瓊後立即舉機，但透過鏡頭見到阿瓊之新形象，驚覺眼前之阿瓊有如仙女下凡，清新脫俗。

programme.title: 真情 #535
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #535
programme.desc: 潤善和標炳知道添福請他們往美國旅行，添福怕詠琴為此事而怒，便自動投案說自己有五千元私己錢，打算請她到日本旅行，詠琴唯一令她喜歡他的原因，便是孝順。尚人為了陪冰雪參加舞會，便往百貨公司買衫，而標漢亦為自己的婚禮而購買西裝，二人各自換過西裝後，都覺得不適合自己，兩人正想找售貨員之際，見對方的尺碼和顏色與自己相約，便提議交換試身。尚人試身後走了，竟遺下手提電話在西裝褸內，此時冰雪致電給尚人，標漢便在西裝褸袋中取出電話來接，不一會，尚人已發現而折返，他覺得標漢有點似曾相識。

programme.title: 真情 #536
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #536
programme.desc: 潤好在機上頻看與標漢之合照，還常偷笑，愛意盡顯。另一邊廂，標漢與尚人同住一層酒店，二人在走廊遇見，標漢與尚人相約往酒吧，言談間，二人甚為投契，便相約下次見面。尚人不小心把潤好送給他的手錶掉在地上，勾起他往日與潤好的甜蜜片段。翌晨，有人拍門，標漢開門竟見潤好、潤善和標炳三人，即呆在當場。標漢與潤好同房，但潤好以為標漢故意預支蜜月，所以便著標漢睡在地上。晚上標漢約了尚人吃飯，潤好他們亦有出席，當他們見到尚人時即大表愕然，但標漢懵然不知。

programme.title: 真情 #537
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #537
programme.desc: 席間，尚人和潤好均不自在，相反，標漢很高興認識尚人，決定再約尚人吃飯。標炳竟將潤好和尚人以前的關係告訴標漢。席間，標漢不斷讚賞潤好如何照顧他及其子女，尚人聞言心酸又心痛，而標漢亦知潤好其實內裏一樣難受。潤好雖然表面上恨透尚人，但標漢感受到潤好對尚人愛之深、恨之切，標漢心情複雜。標漢與標炳在酒吧飲酒，與洋人發生衝突，標漢與標炳被人打傷，他們在醫院求診時，碰巧見到冰雪及碧琪，標漢聽到二人的對話，知道當日尚人拋棄潤好只為了碧琪，並非變心，標漢聽後如晴天霹靂。

programme.title: 真情 #538
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #538
programme.desc: 尚人租了一個有好環境與空氣的單位讓碧琪休養，更提議她往附近教堂做義工，但碧琪發覺尚人對她愈好，她便愈內疚。潤好在公園找到標漢，更發現標漢已知尚人身份，故意逃避她。不過，標漢感到潤好十分關心自己，潤好亦覺得標漢很有安全感，她自小已希望有個像他一樣的大哥，標漢聽了不禁有點心痛，標漢知潤好心中的摯愛仍是尚人。標漢帶潤好到教堂，見碧琪正與教友說自己曾為了挽留尚人，便收起潤好寫給他的信，而她因為救尚人才弄傷腳，使尚人不能回潤好身邊，感到十分內疚，潤好在旁聽見一切，不禁哭起來。

programme.title: 真情 #539
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #539
programme.desc: 碧琪向女牧師剖白，被潤好於不遠處聽見一切，羞愧萬分，冰雪見碧琪淚流滿面，要求潤好離開，此時碧琪把自己推向斜坡，潤好飛身撲上拉著輪椅，碧琪失重心仰前跌下。在醫院，尚人雖知潤好仍愛自己，但忍痛將錶還給潤好，潤好難過。在回酒店途中本想將錶棄掉，但最終還是不捨，發狂似的在垃圾堆中找回錶，標漢和標炳在不遠處看見一切，標漢知潤好對尚人有情，對自己只有義，故決定讓愛。標漢指潤好與尚人有不道德的行為，怒氣沖沖的往醫院找尚人，揚言不會與潤好結婚，潤好聽後心如刀割，但其實標漢的心裏亦很難受。

programme.title: 真情 #540
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #540
programme.desc: 李家怕潤好會自尋短見，但潤好竟然容光煥發，並謂要重新做人。由於潤好因婚事而買的東西很多也不能用，故李家眾人抽簽分配，阿瓊抽到美容優惠套裝。阿貴、清雲及小梅陪阿瓊到美容院，阿貴請美容師將阿瓊脫胎換骨，阿瓊無奈留在美容院任人擺佈。阿瓊被美容師耍弄一番後，致電回家請人拿回她平日的衣服更換，想做回自己。添福與大勝驚見化了妝的阿瓊，故叫子力去看，還要子力拿相機拍下阿瓊的新形象。子力見到阿瓊後立即舉機，但透過鏡頭見到阿瓊之新形象，驚覺眼前之阿瓊有如仙女下凡，清新脫俗。

programme.title: 真情 #535
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #535
programme.desc: 潤善和標炳知道添福請他們往美國旅行，添福怕詠琴為此事而怒，便自動投案說自己有五千元私己錢，打算請她到日本旅行，詠琴唯一令她喜歡他的原因，便是孝順。尚人為了陪冰雪參加舞會，便往百貨公司買衫，而標漢亦為自己的婚禮而購買西裝，二人各自換過西裝後，都覺得不適合自己，兩人正想找售貨員之際，見對方的尺碼和顏色與自己相約，便提議交換試身。尚人試身後走了，竟遺下手提電話在西裝褸內，此時冰雪致電給尚人，標漢便在西裝褸袋中取出電話來接，不一會，尚人已發現而折返，他覺得標漢有點似曾相識。

programme.desc: 尚人租了一個有好環境與空氣的單位讓碧琪休養，更提議她往附近教堂做義工，但碧琪發覺尚人對她愈好，她便愈內疚。潤好在公園找到標漢，更發現標漢已知尚人身份，故意逃避她。不過，標漢感到潤好十分關心自己，潤好亦覺得標漢很有安全感，她自小已希望有個像他一樣的大哥，標漢聽了不禁有點心痛，標漢知潤好心中的摯愛仍是尚人。標漢帶潤好到教堂，見碧琪正與教友說自己曾為了挽留尚人，便收起潤好寫給他的信，而她因為救尚人才弄傷腳，使尚人不能回潤好身邊，感到十分內疚，潤好在旁聽見一切，不禁哭起來。

programme.title: 真情 #539
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #539
programme.desc: 碧琪向女牧師剖白，被潤好於不遠處聽見一切，羞愧萬分，冰雪見碧琪淚流滿面，要求潤好離開，此時碧琪把自己推向斜坡，潤好飛身撲上拉著輪椅，碧琪失重心仰前跌下。在醫院，尚人雖知潤好仍愛自己，但忍痛將錶還給潤好，潤好難過。在回酒店途中本想將錶棄掉，但最終還是不捨，發狂似的在垃圾堆中找回錶，標漢和標炳在不遠處看見一切，標漢知潤好對尚人有情，對自己只有義，故決定讓愛。標漢指潤好與尚人有不道德的行為，怒氣沖沖的往醫院找尚人，揚言不會與潤好結婚，潤好聽後心如刀割，但其實標漢的心裏亦很難受。

programme.title: 真情 #540
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #540
programme.desc: 李家怕潤好會自尋短見，但潤好竟然容光煥發，並謂要重新做人。由於潤好因婚事而買的東西很多也不能用，故李家眾人抽簽分配，阿瓊抽到美容優惠套裝。阿貴、清雲及小梅陪阿瓊到美容院，阿貴請美容師將阿瓊脫胎換骨，阿瓊無奈留在美容院任人擺佈。阿瓊被美容師耍弄一番後，致電回家請人拿回她平日的衣服更換，想做回自己。添福與大勝驚見化了妝的阿瓊，故叫子力去看，還要子力拿相機拍下阿瓊的新形象。子力見到阿瓊後立即舉機，但透過鏡頭見到阿瓊之新形象，驚覺眼前之阿瓊有如仙女下凡，清新脫俗。

programme.title: 真情 #535
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #535
programme.desc: 潤善和標炳知道添福請他們往美國旅行，添福怕詠琴為此事而怒，便自動投案說自己有五千元私己錢，打算請她到日本旅行，詠琴唯一令她喜歡他的原因，便是孝順。尚人為了陪冰雪參加舞會，便往百貨公司買衫，而標漢亦為自己的婚禮而購買西裝，二人各自換過西裝後，都覺得不適合自己，兩人正想找售貨員之際，見對方的尺碼和顏色與自己相約，便提議交換試身。尚人試身後走了，竟遺下手提電話在西裝褸內，此時冰雪致電給尚人，標漢便在西裝褸袋中取出電話來接，不一會，尚人已發現而折返，他覺得標漢有點似曾相識。

programme.title: 真情 #536
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #536
programme.desc: 潤好在機上頻看與標漢之合照，還常偷笑，愛意盡顯。另一邊廂，標漢與尚人同住一層酒店，二人在走廊遇見，標漢與尚人相約往酒吧，言談間，二人甚為投契，便相約下次見面。尚人不小心把潤好送給他的手錶掉在地上，勾起他往日與潤好的甜蜜片段。翌晨，有人拍門，標漢開門竟見潤好、潤善和標炳三人，即呆在當場。標漢與潤好同房，但潤好以為標漢故意預支蜜月，所以便著標漢睡在地上。晚上標漢約了尚人吃飯，潤好他們亦有出席，當他們見到尚人時即大表愕然，但標漢懵然不知。

programme.title: 真情 #537
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #537
programme.desc: 席間，尚人和潤好均不自在，相反，標漢很高興認識尚人，決定再約尚人吃飯。標炳竟將潤好和尚人以前的關係告訴標漢。席間，標漢不斷讚賞潤好如何照顧他及其子女，尚人聞言心酸又心痛，而標漢亦知潤好其實內裏一樣難受。潤好雖然表面上恨透尚人，但標漢感受到潤好對尚人愛之深、恨之切，標漢心情複雜。標漢與標炳在酒吧飲酒，與洋人發生衝突，標漢與標炳被人打傷，他們在醫院求診時，碰巧見到冰雪及碧琪，標漢聽到二人的對話，知道當日尚人拋棄潤好只為了碧琪，並非變心，標漢聽後如晴天霹靂。

programme.desc: 李家怕潤好會自尋短見，但潤好竟然容光煥發，並謂要重新做人。由於潤好因婚事而買的東西很多也不能用，故李家眾人抽簽分配，阿瓊抽到美容優惠套裝。阿貴、清雲及小梅陪阿瓊到美容院，阿貴請美容師將阿瓊脫胎換骨，阿瓊無奈留在美容院任人擺佈。阿瓊被美容師耍弄一番後，致電回家請人拿回她平日的衣服更換，想做回自己。添福與大勝驚見化了妝的阿瓊，故叫子力去看，還要子力拿相機拍下阿瓊的新形象。子力見到阿瓊後立即舉機，但透過鏡頭見到阿瓊之新形象，驚覺眼前之阿瓊有如仙女下凡，清新脫俗。

programme.title: 真情 #535
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #535
programme.desc: 潤善和標炳知道添福請他們往美國旅行，添福怕詠琴為此事而怒，便自動投案說自己有五千元私己錢，打算請她到日本旅行，詠琴唯一令她喜歡他的原因，便是孝順。尚人為了陪冰雪參加舞會，便往百貨公司買衫，而標漢亦為自己的婚禮而購買西裝，二人各自換過西裝後，都覺得不適合自己，兩人正想找售貨員之際，見對方的尺碼和顏色與自己相約，便提議交換試身。尚人試身後走了，竟遺下手提電話在西裝褸內，此時冰雪致電給尚人，標漢便在西裝褸袋中取出電話來接，不一會，尚人已發現而折返，他覺得標漢有點似曾相識。

programme.title: 真情 #536
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #536
programme.desc: 潤好在機上頻看與標漢之合照，還常偷笑，愛意盡顯。另一邊廂，標漢與尚人同住一層酒店，二人在走廊遇見，標漢與尚人相約往酒吧，言談間，二人甚為投契，便相約下次見面。尚人不小心把潤好送給他的手錶掉在地上，勾起他往日與潤好的甜蜜片段。翌晨，有人拍門，標漢開門竟見潤好、潤善和標炳三人，即呆在當場。標漢與潤好同房，但潤好以為標漢故意預支蜜月，所以便著標漢睡在地上。晚上標漢約了尚人吃飯，潤好他們亦有出席，當他們見到尚人時即大表愕然，但標漢懵然不知。

programme.title: 真情 #537
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #537
programme.desc: 席間，尚人和潤好均不自在，相反，標漢很高興認識尚人，決定再約尚人吃飯。標炳竟將潤好和尚人以前的關係告訴標漢。席間，標漢不斷讚賞潤好如何照顧他及其子女，尚人聞言心酸又心痛，而標漢亦知潤好其實內裏一樣難受。潤好雖然表面上恨透尚人，但標漢感受到潤好對尚人愛之深、恨之切，標漢心情複雜。標漢與標炳在酒吧飲酒，與洋人發生衝突，標漢與標炳被人打傷，他們在醫院求診時，碰巧見到冰雪及碧琪，標漢聽到二人的對話，知道當日尚人拋棄潤好只為了碧琪，並非變心，標漢聽後如晴天霹靂。

programme.title: 真情 #538
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #538
programme.desc: 尚人租了一個有好環境與空氣的單位讓碧琪休養，更提議她往附近教堂做義工，但碧琪發覺尚人對她愈好，她便愈內疚。潤好在公園找到標漢，更發現標漢已知尚人身份，故意逃避她。不過，標漢感到潤好十分關心自己，潤好亦覺得標漢很有安全感，她自小已希望有個像他一樣的大哥，標漢聽了不禁有點心痛，標漢知潤好心中的摯愛仍是尚人。標漢帶潤好到教堂，見碧琪正與教友說自己曾為了挽留尚人，便收起潤好寫給他的信，而她因為救尚人才弄傷腳，使尚人不能回潤好身邊，感到十分內疚，潤好在旁聽見一切，不禁哭起來。

programme.title: 真情 #539
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #539
programme.desc: 碧琪向女牧師剖白，被潤好於不遠處聽見一切，羞愧萬分，冰雪見碧琪淚流滿面，要求潤好離開，此時碧琪把自己推向斜坡，潤好飛身撲上拉著輪椅，碧琪失重心仰前跌下。在醫院，尚人雖知潤好仍愛自己，但忍痛將錶還給潤好，潤好難過。在回酒店途中本想將錶棄掉，但最終還是不捨，發狂似的在垃圾堆中找回錶，標漢和標炳在不遠處看見一切，標漢知潤好對尚人有情，對自己只有義，故決定讓愛。標漢指潤好與尚人有不道德的行為，怒氣沖沖的往醫院找尚人，揚言不會與潤好結婚，潤好聽後心如刀割，但其實標漢的心裏亦很難受。

programme.title: 真情 #541
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #541
programme.desc: 眾人拿著子力所拍的照片取笑阿瓊。阿瓊更衣後，子力一見她，心中被她泛起的漣漪仍未平息，故極力避開阿瓊的目光。阿福與大勝以為子力鍾意一女明星，教他解救方法，即盡量避開對方，免得日久生情，故子力決定避免見到阿瓊，暫時不到李家用膳。阿瓊見子力遲遲未到李家，便致電子力，子力假裝有女生請他到酒店吃飯，但其實一個人在碼頭吃飯盒。一天，夏枯草在另一邊叫救命，表示阿瓊跌進海裏，子力大為緊張，不加思索立即跳下海，將阿瓊救上來後才知只是同名的女生而已。

programme.title: 真情 #542
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #542
programme.desc: 阿福與大勝知子力愛上阿瓊，二人決幫子力，但又要子力幫他們做工作。子力在片場看見一武師之妻拿飯盒到片場與老公同吃，非常溫馨。另一武師見子力羨慕的表情，便鼓勵子力努力工作，將來一定可以娶到好老婆，子力開心地想像與阿瓊將來的美滿生活。清雲與詠琴發現阿福與大勝收入突然增加，逼供之下，二人大爆子力愛上阿瓊，故收買他們。眾人愕然。容姨知道子力愛上阿瓊後，認為子力難以保護、照顧阿瓊，要求子力一世也不要讓阿瓊知道此事，子力黯然答應。

programme.title: 真情 #543
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #543
programme.desc: 大勝與添福叫雞坤將亞萊與阿瓊一起時的片段重演，必定能奪取阿瓊的芳心。一天，阿瓊與子力一起送燒豬，大勝施計令他們碰上正瑟縮一角、淋著雨的雞坤。阿瓊上前問他何故淪落街頭，他聲稱其母在澳洲病重，但因身無分文而未能探望，實際在佔阿瓊便宜，阿瓊沒有留意他的舉動，更樂意幫助他，子力不滿。雞坤又模仿亞萊拉小提琴，令阿瓊急步離開。雞坤追上，竟邀阿瓊跟他一起踩單車，阿瓊頓醒覺他在摸仿亞萊，責他卑鄙，雞坤見情況不妙，立刻離開。同時，子力向阿瓊表明心意，阿瓊沒有反應，令子力失意地離開。

programme.title: 真情 #544
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #544
programme.desc: 子浩與亞美蜜月返港前一日，容姨已將行李搬往亞南家，好讓她能每天見到子浩，子浩在蜜月期間，聽從齡高的意思，將一個腎移植給亞美。亞美發現了容姨的行李，知道她欲搬進來，立即說她已有足夠的工人，容姨十分難受，只好把行李搬回李家。子浩返李家用膳，但到達前被污水淋濕，故往淋浴更衣。正當他在浴室圍著毛巾之際，容姨突然走入，子浩雖立刻以毛巾遮掩身上因移植腎臟手術所造成之傷口，但依然被容姨發覺，在她追問下，子浩只好坦然承認他捐了一個腎予亞美，令容姨大為驚訝。

programme.title: 真情 #545
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 3/97 #545
programme.desc: 子浩叫亞美與容姨吃飯，亞美講出一番刻薄的話，看在子浩份上勉強答應。眾人在酒樓品茗時，亞美姍姍來遲之餘，還不滿他們沒有替她預備好食物，橫蠻地命令阿貴往九龍城替她買炸兩，阿貴雖不忿，但為顧及容姨的感受惟有答應。阿貴約了阿瓊逛街，故意不理買炸兩一事，當晚，李家十分擔心阿貴，恐防她出意外，更指責亞美不是，阿貴此時回來，自認與阿瓊逛街，阿美乘機罵她一番，二人發生爭執，容姨突然大聲喝道，指出是阿貴不對，阿貴淚水奪眶而出，而向海只理會容姨，她立即衝出門外，向海與潤善追上。

programme.title: 真情 #546
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 3/97 #546
programme.desc: 向海陪阿貴檢查，知道嬰兒是男孩，阿貴開心。石敏被雜誌社遣派回港做名人專訪，其中的對象包括亞南。亞南與石敏及其家人用膳，石表叔明知子浩與李家在酒家吃飯，故意前往。酒樓內，兩家人被安排坐在同一貴賓廳內，兩家人分檯而坐，子浩暗凝望敏，被亞美發現，更刻意流露出不滿。石敏上洗手間，亞美即跟入，潤善與阿貴見狀也追上。洗手間內，亞美刻意與石敏爭用設施，潤善見情況不妙，催亞美離去，但她卻突然摑了石敏一掌，還放下一張十萬元的支票給石敏後離開，石敏掩著面哭了起來。

programme.title: 真情 #541
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #541
programme.desc: 眾人拿著子力所拍的照片取笑阿瓊。阿瓊更衣後，子力一見她，心中被她泛起的漣漪仍未平息，故極力避開阿瓊的目光。阿福與大勝以為子力鍾意一女明星，教他解救方法，即盡量避開對方，免得日久生情，故子力決定避免見到阿瓊，暫時不到李家用膳。阿瓊見子力遲遲未到李家，便致電子力，子力假裝有女生請他到酒店吃飯，但其實一個人在碼頭吃飯盒。一天，夏枯草在另一邊叫救命，表示阿瓊跌進海裏，子力大為緊張，不加思索立即跳下海，將阿瓊救上來後才知只是同名的女生而已。

programme.title: 真情 #542
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #542
programme.desc: 阿福與大勝知子力愛上阿瓊，二人決幫子力，但又要子力幫他們做工作。子力在片場看見一武師之妻拿飯盒到片場與老公同吃，非常溫馨。另一武師見子力羨慕的表情，便鼓勵子力努力工作，將來一定可以娶到好老婆，子力開心地想像與阿瓊將來的美滿生活。清雲與詠琴發現阿福與大勝收入突然增加，逼供之下，二人大爆子力愛上阿瓊，故收買他們。眾人愕然。容姨知道子力愛上阿瓊後，認為子力難以保護、照顧阿瓊，要求子力一世也不要讓阿瓊知道此事，子力黯然答應。

programme.title: 真情 #543
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #543
programme.desc: 大勝與添福叫雞坤將亞萊與阿瓊一起時的片段重演，必定能奪取阿瓊的芳心。一天，阿瓊與子力一起送燒豬，大勝施計令他們碰上正瑟縮一角、淋著雨的雞坤。阿瓊上前問他何故淪落街頭，他聲稱其母在澳洲病重，但因身無分文而未能探望，實際在佔阿瓊便宜，阿瓊沒有留意他的舉動，更樂意幫助他，子力不滿。雞坤又模仿亞萊拉小提琴，令阿瓊急步離開。雞坤追上，竟邀阿瓊跟他一起踩單車，阿瓊頓醒覺他在摸仿亞萊，責他卑鄙，雞坤見情況不妙，立刻離開。同時，子力向阿瓊表明心意，阿瓊沒有反應，令子力失意地離開。

programme.title: 真情 #544
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 2/97 #544
programme.desc: 子浩與亞美蜜月返港前一日，容姨已將行李搬往亞南家，好讓她能每天見到子浩，子浩在蜜月期間，聽從齡高的意思，將一個腎移植給亞美。亞美發現了容姨的行李，知道她欲搬進來，立即說她已有足夠的工人，容姨十分難受，只好把行李搬回李家。子浩返李家用膳，但到達前被污水淋濕，故往淋浴更衣。正當他在浴室圍著毛巾之際，容姨突然走入，子浩雖立刻以毛巾遮掩身上因移植腎臟手術所造成之傷口，但依然被容姨發覺，在她追問下，子浩只好坦然承認他捐了一個腎予亞美，令容姨大為驚訝。

programme.title: 真情 #545
KINDRED SPIRIT, A 3/97 #545
programme.desc: 子浩叫亞美與容姨吃飯，亞美講出一番刻薄的話，看在子浩份上勉強答應。眾人在酒樓品茗時，亞美姍姍來遲之餘，還不滿他們沒有替她預備好食物，橫蠻地命令阿貴往九龍城替她買炸兩，阿貴雖不忿，但為顧及容姨的感受惟有答應。阿貴約了阿瓊逛街，故意不理買炸兩一事，當晚，李家十分擔心阿貴，恐防她出意外，更指責亞美不是，阿貴此時回來，自認與阿瓊逛街，阿美乘機罵她一番，二人發生爭執，容姨突然大聲喝道，指出是阿貴不對，阿貴淚水奪眶而出，而向海只理會容姨，她立即衝出門外，向海與潤善追上。
